title: Galileo is forced to recant heliocentrism
summary: The Roman Inquisition found Galileo vehemently suspect of heresy, and he formally abjured the view that the Earth moves around the Sun; he spent the rest of his life under house arrest.
reason: His Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems had defended Copernicus and offended Pope Urban VIII.
significance: The trial became the classic example of conflict between science and religious authority.
place: Santa Maria sopra Minerva, Rome, Italy
